name: OWEB Focused Investment Partnership (FIP) Initiatives
summary: Six-year funding for high-performing partnerships delivering restoration, acquisition, technical assistance, engagement and monitoring work plans in Oregon, around board-set priorities such as aquatic habitat, dry forest, estuaries, oak and prairie, closed-lakes wetlands and sage-steppe. Core partners such as tribes, watershed councils and nonprofits apply.

amount.note: Cap per partnership is $5 million per biennium and up to $15 million over the 6-year Initiative
